主要内容: On February 1, 2012, Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc.'s subsidiary, R. L. Drake Holdings, LLC, entered into an asset purchase agreement with R. L. Drake, LLC, R. L. Drake Acquisition Corporation, and WBMK Holding Company. The agreement involved the acquisition of substantially all of R. L. Drake, LLC's assets, including manufacturing equipment, inventory, receivables, and intellectual property related to electronic communications solutions for cable television systems, digital television reception, and video signal distribution. The purchase price was approximately $6,476,995, subject to adjustments, plus contingent payments of up to $1,500,000 over three years if certain financial results are achieved. The acquisition includes indemnification obligations and a five-year non-compete clause for the seller and its members. The company issued a press release on February 2, 2012, announcing the acquisition, which is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Financial statements and pro forma information are not included in the report but are intended to be filed by amendment within 71 calendar days. The acquisition is expected to impact the company's operations and industry position.
